narrative.executive_summary: Acme Yield offers two products: a note (P1) financing equipment leases through a credit fund and a warehouse SPV (T1), and a vault (P2) financing commodity purchase and resale (T2). Entities are mapped to layers; the security over the T1 loans is disputed between sources.
